originality.rationale: The motivating Tang–Tang paper asks general factorization questions. Liggett 2021 independently proves the same 21-trial distribution is not P4 and is P6, but his complete accessible discussion contains no P5 construction; neither published statement implies the precise index. Targeted mathematical-claim index and literature queries found no equivalent P5 factorization; unindexed work remains possible.

value.rationale: The 21-trial distribution is the explicit central obstruction in Liggett’s strong-Rayleigh rational rounding analysis, for which he published P4 failure and P6 membership. The exact smallest admissible independent-summand alphabet was undetermined. Closing it to 5 gives a natural complete classification of a canonical example and an explicit positive 2/5/5 convolution, rather than an arbitrary finite invariant.
